purpose: Teach: 桐/天狗/ダニ/シティー/飛び込み/海水浴/リハビリテーション/ヘビ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが桐の箪笥を作って下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father made me a paulownia chest of drawers.
lines.style: Distant, tender opening. Soft attack on the first word. Voice drifts into memory — slow, measured pace. Eyes perhaps looking past her into the past. Each image held briefly before releasing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に天狗のお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, didn't Grandpa tell you that story about the tengu, dear?
lines.style: Warm, meandering. Gently woven thread of her own memory threading through his. Soft chuckle underneath. Patient — she's not correcting, just adding her own thread. Affectionate at the close.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはダニを退治するご様子を見せて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father showed me how he dealt with the mites in the wood.
lines.style: Same distant, memory-held quality as the opening. Voice stays quiet, intimate. Slightly more present than before — this was a lesson, a small transmission. Careful precision on the action itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、シティーホテルに泊まる機会もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And didn't you get to stay at that fancy city hotel, dear?
lines.style: Gently tangential. She's threading her own memory into his — not interrupting, but weaving. Warm curiosity. Slight lift at the end, as if inviting him to remember alongside her. Patient, companionable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがプールで飛び込みをされた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father dove into the pool.
lines.style: Voice opens even softer this time. A tender image held in silence. Slow, almost wondering pace. The memory of his father's body in motion — young, alive. Trailing quietness at the end, letting it sit.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏に海水浴に連れて行って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You took me to the seaside for swimming in the summer, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, gentle invitation to memory. She's shifting the focus — from his father to him, to them. Soft, encouraging lilt. Voice wraps around the question like an embrace. Not testing — offering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがリハビリテーションをされた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father went through rehabilitation.
lines.style: Tone shifts — quieter, more weighted. Opening is still soft but carries something heavier underneath. Pace slows further. This memory has depth and pain beneath it. Breath held slightly. Voice thins at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お庭でヘビを見つけて驚かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You found a snake in the garden and got such a fright, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Lighter, bringing gentle warmth back. She's shifting the tone again — away from weight, toward the small, ordinary moments. Warm chuckle. Voice closes soft and near, as if she's drawn in closer. Tender finish.
